comments: Registered as one bank on the footing line; the pivot x is the centre of the footing stones. The lit crop has the ajar door four source pixels below the footing line; a reviewed sub-crop ends it on the line shared with the other two (the door tip is the only thing cut). Painted 48 of 48 px wide.

A reviewed ink grade keeps the weathered timber and the contour brown: the palette snap had sent brown-grey flecks (source about 806241) to an olive ink (69793e) and the dark brown outline (source about 221d1b) to a dark green one (182414); the grade maps those two admitted shared inks to the browns 684629 and 25140b; no pixel is moved, added or removed.
